questions.question: What creature does the LORD punish in Isaiah 27?
options: The lion that prowls by night
The eagle that soars on high
Behemoth, the beast of the field

questions.question: How is Israel pictured again in Isaiah 27?
options: A scattered flock left wandering upon the high mountains
A pleasant vineyard that the LORD keeps and waters
A barren and empty field all overgrown with thorns
A great city laid utterly waste by all of its enemies
questions.answer: A pleasant vineyard that the LORD keeps and waters

questions.question: Isaiah 27 says in days to come Jacob shall take root, and Israel shall blossom and fill the world with fruit.
In that day, a pleasant _____, sing of it! I, the LORD, am its keeper.
In days to come Jacob shall take root, Israel shall blossom and put forth shoots and fill the whole world with _____.
